question: Which famous female personality received the Padma Shri award for manipuri classical dance?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Elam Endira Devi **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Elam Endira Devi received the Padma Shri award for Manipuri classical dance.**
 
• She was a renowned** Indian classical dancer and choreographer from Manipur.**
 
• Devi was also known for her contributions in promoting Manipuri dance globally.
 
• She was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1969 and the Padma Shri in 1972 for her contributions to the field of classical dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalabati Devi:** She was a renowned Indian classical dancer from Manipur. She was known for her contributions in promoting Manipuri dance forms in India and abroad. However, she did not receive the Padma Shri award for manipuri classical dance.
 
• **Devyani Chalia:** She is an Indian classical dancer from Gujarat. She is known for her expertise in Kathak dance form. She has not received the Padma Shri award for Manipuri classical dance.
 
• **Charu Mathur**: She is an Indian classical dancer from Rajasthan. She is known for her contributions in promoting Rajasthani folk dance forms. She has not received the Padma Shri award for Manipuri classical dance.
